title: The Classic
description: The King's own pawns are his prison. Drive the Queen forward to force the Knight's checkmate.

title: Corner Trap
description: The King is cornered. Use the Queen to clear the way, then let the Knight finish.

title: The Offer
description: Sacrifice the Queen to smother the King with its own Rook. The Knight waits to pounce.

title: Zugzwang Smother
description: Every King move tightens the net. The Knight waits while the Queen herds.

title: The Windmill
description: Drive the King across the board with a sequence of checks, then smother it with your Knight.
